method: V156 Insight edge discount, authored from the pinned Compendium only. Builds reuse reviewed witnesses unchanged (paths in each 'base'). The full cost N is the ability file's printed cost. The discount applies when the use has a net edge after edges and banes cancel; the paid amount, the pool after and the block come from that arithmetic alone. Nothing is derived from the evaluator, the resolver or a run of the code under test.

sources.claim: Insight in Combat: "Whenever you use a heroic ability that makes use of a power roll, that ability costs 1 fewer insight if you have an edge or double edge on it." Insight Outside of Combat waives the cost, so every use here is inside a committed encounter.
Rolling With Edges and Banes: an edge and a bane cancel (no edges or banes); a double edge and one bane leave one edge.
cost: 3 Insight; Power Roll + Agility; target: One creature. A heroic ability (it has an insight cost) that makes use of a power roll.

shadow.note: Level-one Black Ash Shadow, unchanged. Its 3-insight choice is Disorienting Strike (class.shadow.ability-3).

target.note: The reviewed V154 target: Human Censor, no damage immunity or weakness, no automatic edge or bane. Stamina is set to 40 before each damage use so no hit takes it to dying.

foe.note: Keeps both sides populated so the committed encounter stays in combat, as in V154.

steps.derivation: One edge, no bane: net edge. 3 - 1 = 2 paid; 3 - 2 = 1 left.
No edge: full cost 3 paid; 3 - 3 = 0 left.
An edge and a bane cancel: no edge, so the cost stays 3. A pool of 2 cannot pay 3: blocked, no roll, pool unchanged at 2.
A double edge and one bane leave one edge: 3 - 1 = 2 paid; 2 - 2 = 0 left.
